text:
Sam: Heads-up: EU ingest had a transient S3 spike and kafka commits lagged. We have ~36-48h of late telemetry and hourly dashboards are stale. Proposing a staged replay instead of full shard rehydration. Thoughts?
Omar: staged + sampling works. last time full shards blew past budget.
Leah: must show cost estimate in Console before start. operators need visibility.
Priya: suggest two windows: hot=last12h full; warm=12-72h sampled 10%. cold>72h skip. Add deterministic sampling so reruns reproduce.
Ryan: runner should tag origin of gap (eg origin=s3-eu-3113) and include backfill-id header so traces/billing link to the run.
sre-bot: alert resolved: ingest-eu-s3-3113321000 30m ago.
Sam: proto policy: priority_stagger_v1 with hot_window=12h, warm_sample_pct=10, low_priority_concurrency=40, per_tenant_slots=2, commit_hot=atomic, commit_warm=partial.
Omar: need selector SQL example for deterministic sample. Leah: hash(tenant_id||hour) % 100 < 10 is fine. Put sample_seed in config.
Priya: also want dry-run API in Console that returns est_cpu_hours, est_rows_touched, est_s3_gb, est_duration and estimated cost. auto-abort if cost > threshold.
console-bot: dry-run endpoint: POST /replay/dryrun returns {estimate_cpu_hours, estimate_s3_gb, rows_touched}.
Ryan: will add origin tag + staging-table swap for atomic hot commits. ETA today.
Leah: devex will draft Console copy and a one-click template named "EU staged rehydrate". include a canary option (1% tenants) before full hot run.
Sam: I'll draft YAML and wire dry-run. Quick config below for ops trial: 
``npriority_policy: priority_stagger_v1
hot_window: 12h
warm_window: 72h
warm_sample_pct: 10
low_priority_concurrency: 40
per_tenant_slots: 2
commit_mode_hot: atomic
commit_mode_warm: partial
trace_header: x-replay-backfill-id
```
Omar: LGTM. tag me on PR for dry-run cost calc.
Priya: I'll add unit tests for idempotent dedupe and watermarking using event_ingest_time.
Sam: plan: enable dry-run + canary, verify evals, then start hot full run, then warm sampled sweep. Ping #eng-sre on blockers. :thumbsup:
